import type { HTMLAttributes } from "react";

export function Direction({ dir, className = "", ...props }: HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement> & { dir: "ltr" | "rtl" }) { return <div dir={dir} className={`${dir === "rtl" ? "co-direction-rtl" : "co-direction-ltr"} ${className}`.trim()} {...props} />; }

meta.accessibility: Uses semantic HTML, preserves keyboard operation, exposes visible focus, and keeps accessible naming under consumer control.
